text:
mira_sales: Urgent  Cobalt Commerce escalated to execs. They require BYO-KMS (prefer HSM), a hard throughput SLA for holiday promos, and SOC2-compliant audit evidence. Procurement also asked for a capital purchase option (PO by EOD). Can infra/legal/pricing own this? cc @owen_solutions @raj_infra @sofia_legal @ben_pricing

owen_solutions: I can coordinate tech. Need exact traffic curve and desired p95/p99. Any documents?

mira_sales: Customer sent a short export: peak ~13k req/min for 10-20min promo bursts, baseline ~2.8k. p95 goal 150ms. I'll attach the spreadsheet to the invite.

raj_infra: Quick take: with warmed KV caches our dedicated config does ~11k sustained. For 13k bursts we can (A) add a small reserved burst pool (+2.5k) for tight SLA, or (B) autoscale with warm standby and prefix caching for cost savings but slightly higher risk. HSM/BYO-KMS likely needs VPC peering or Private deployment - adds lead time.

sofia_legal: CISO asked for explicit key custody + audit log access plus SOC2 evidence. I'll draft a short amendment for BYO-KMS and a checklist of required attestations (rotation cadence, compromise notif window, access matrix). Need to know which KMS vendors they'd use and whether in-country HSM is required.

ben_pricing: Capex flow OK. I can prepare a 12- or 24-month amortized purchase quote, but I need a per-month delta between reserved pool vs autoscale to build the PO numbers.

carmen_prod: I'll prepare a customer-facing SLA options doc that lists fallbacks (model variant downgrade, regional failover) and acceptance criteria if traffic exceeds the SLA.

owen_solutions: I'll post a 1-page ops note by 11:30 with assumptions, option A vs B, warm-cache latency estimates, and rough cost delta. Also flag timeline impact for HSM (approx 3-5w).

sofia_legal: Drafting amendment now. Will include attestation fields and a short consent form for key access during incident response. Posting by 2pm.

ops_bot: Ticket INC-53421 created - "Cobalt Commerce exec escalation: BYO-KMS + throughput + SOC2 evidence". Assigned to infra-team oncall.

mira_sales: Recap/action items: (1) raj/owen - ops note + numbers by 11:30, (2) ben - capex PO template once delta provided, (3) sofia - draft amendment by 2pm, (4) carmen - SLA doc, (5) I'll schedule a 30-min exec bridge with their CISO/procurement for 4pm ET. Post artifacts here. :thumbsup:
